text:
Maya: Heads up, billing spike for tenant client-x this morning, +1.9% predicted. Noticed many events with route_tag empty.
Rahul: Saw that on the hourly rollup, default-route attribution jumped around 10:05 UTC.
Jon: Pushed proxy patch to trim headers (PR 1337) at 10:04 canary 5%.
DeployBot: deploy-bot: edge-proxy v2.4.1 canary -> 2026-03-21T10:04 completed.
Maya: Sample event: {event_id:evt_X, tenant:client-x, session:sess-9, tokens:120, route_tag:""} -> empty string not missing.
Rahul: Our metering consumer treats empty-string as a present tag and validates against known routes; unknown -> fallback to default-route SKU.
Leah: We should treat empty/"null"/absent consistently. Patch suggestion: normalize empty string -> null at ingress so consumer can join session map.
Jon: Rolling back canary and will revert header normalization.
DeployBot: deploy-bot: rollback initiated at 10:12 -> edge-proxy v2.4.0.
Ellie: Console ask: add metric metering.routeless_rate and alert if > 0.4% over 10m. Also add a small UX toaster when invoices preview changes >0.5% after rollouts.
Rahul: Quick repair plan: 1) query events with empty route_tag in last 3h, 2) join sessions.route_map to backfill, 3) publish to billing-replay topic, run dry-run invoice. SQL: SELECT e.event_id FROM billing.events e WHERE e.route_tag = '' AND e.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM sessions.route_map WHERE ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '3 hours');
Maya: Kicking off backfill job now. Will report counts.
Ops-Bot: ops-bot: incident created 2026-03-21-686001. Channel #inc-686001.
Jon: Postmortem items: add e2e test for header_contract, make edge proxy preserve unknown headers as-is, and update metering consumer to treat empty as missing for 48h as a fallback.
Maya: Thanks. I'll post replay numbers when done.
